about_the_game:
The galaxy has fallen to alien infestations. You are humanity’s last hope to push back the swarm.
Lost Galaxy: Survivors is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter with roguelike action, mission objectives, and long-term progression. Each run drops you into hostile worlds teeming with alien hordes—survive, complete objectives, and reclaim lost planets one battle at a time.

Key Features

  • Intense Survival Combat
    Blast through endless waves of alien creatures in fast, skill-based top-down shooting.

  • Mission-Based Objectives
    Go beyond survival: install beacons, destroy alien hives, gather resources, and complete objectives to cleanse infested worlds.

  • Roguelike Replayability
    Every mission is different. Choose upgrades, weapons, and perks that evolve your build with each run.

  • Cleanse Infested Worlds
    Progress through diverse environments—deserts, frozen wastelands, volcanic fields—each with unique challenges and alien threats.

  • Meta Progression
    Unlock new characters, weapons, and permanent upgrades that carry over between runs.

  • Strategic Choices
    Decide how to spend resources—upgrade your arsenal, boost survivability, or prepare for the next mission.

  • Sci-Fi Atmosphere
    Explore vibrant, hostile planets with immersive visuals and relentless alien swarms.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or above
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, Apple Silicon (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Intel Iris, AMD, Apple M1/M2)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Tahoe 26 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3 recommended) or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated or dedicated AMD GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD RX 590, 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
